Integrated Brick + Deep Space

Brick that lives inside space.

This version does not fake a hole in the wall. The brick texture is blended into a full-screen deep-space field so the whole wall feels like it exists in the same environment, instead of a layer pasted over a cutout.

No Fake Hole

The space field runs behind the entire scene, not only inside a visible opening.

Real Material Blend

The brick is treated like texture and light response, not a sticker layer sitting on top.

Depth Everywhere

Stars, nebula, glow, and vignette all push the environment farther back so it feels infinite.

Full self-contained code

This HTML is fully self-contained and uses your uploaded brick image embedded directly into the file. 

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Cosmic Brick Wall</title>
  <!-- Full CSS is included in the downloadable file -->
</head>
<body>
  <div class="space-root">
    <div class="nebula"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="brick-space"></div>
  <div class="space-light"></div>
  <div class="depth-vignette"></div>

  <main class="shell">
    <section class="hero">
      <div class="hero-card">
        <div class="eyebrow">Integrated Brick + Deep Space</div>
        <h1>Brick that lives inside space.</h1>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <script>
    function toggleBrick() {
      const layer = document.querySelector(".brick-space");
      const current = getComputedStyle(layer).opacity;
      layer.style.opacity = current === "0.45" ? "1" : "0.45";
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
Use the downloadable file for the full exact implementation with the embedded brick texture.
